title: Assign an Account membership role in Boss Admin

gates.name: admin_role_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/admin-role.spec.ts

verify: Independent Boss/non-Boss browser verification covers exact membership role assignment, invalid role, last-Boss protection, and authoritative reread.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-013 RED: no Boss browser action assigns a membership role; GREEN: the registered role action changes exactly the selected membership while invalid/non-Boss/last-Boss requests fail without mutation; decisive comparison: request body, response/DOM, and authoritative membership/audit reread; artifact: role evidence under .tasks/TASK-096-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose the accepted membership-role action without combining it with Account creation, Plant grants, lifecycle, or audit presentation.
success_outcome: A Boss can assign one registered membership role through backend authority while invalid, non-Boss, and last-Boss paths remain non-mutating.
anti_goals: Do not create Accounts, manage Plants/grants, read audit, invent roles, or alter session/password state.
Do not weaken last-active-Boss or Consultant authority rules.

stop_conditions: The UI requires a role or permission outside Boss Admin HTTP.
Role assignment cannot preserve last-Boss protection and same-transaction audit authority.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Access & Admin owns membership and audit mutation.
Send only role_preset and trust the safe backend result.
invariants: Frontend role visibility grants no authority.
A rejected role request changes neither membership nor audit state.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-013: exact membership-role assignment with invalid/non-Boss/last-Boss rejection and authoritative reread.
T3 harm proof uses isolated memberships and verifies safe rerun cannot demote the last active Boss or grant unintended authority.
